snippet.title: Super Mario XP - Full Gameplay
snippet.description:
Visit my website:
https://www.matth33w.com/

Another childhood piece, seriously, i love this kaizo style. It's not that hard, it's not that easy, and IT'S FAIR! This is another big inspiration to develop The End of Mushroom Kingdom, fun fact: TEOMK was supposed to be a remake for this game lol
